summary: Tested Push Notification System and Flash Sale Toast features. All 15 backend tests passed (VAPID key endpoint, subscribe/unsubscribe, admin stats, admin send, flash sale auto-trigger). Frontend verified: Notification bell visible in header (data-testid='notification-bell'), Flash Sale toast shows on homepage when flash sale is active with bundle name, savings, Shop button (navigates to bundle page), and dismiss button. Toast dismissal stores session flag and prevents re-showing. Toast correctly hidden on admin pages. Service worker exists at /sw-push.js with 'Shop Now' action.
critical_code_review_comments: notification_routes.py: VAPID keys loaded from env vars correctly
notification_routes.py: subscribe endpoint validates endpoint + keys.p256dh + keys.auth
notification_routes.py: send_push_to_all handles WebPushException and cleans up expired subscriptions (410/404)
notification_routes.py: admin/stats returns total_subscriptions, active_subscriptions, recent_notifications
bundle_routes.py: update_bundle triggers send_push_to_all when flash sale is newly activated (was_flash=False, now_flash=True)
NotificationSystem.jsx: NotificationBell checks for serviceWorker and PushManager support before rendering
NotificationSystem.jsx: FlashSaleToast checks sessionStorage 'pigma_flash_dismissed' before showing
NotificationSystem.jsx: handleDismiss sets sessionStorage flag and hides toast
App.js: LayoutWrapper hides FlashSaleToast on admin/vendor/reseller pages (hideChrome logic)
sw-push.js: Service worker handles push events with 'Shop Now' and 'Dismiss' actions
seed_data_creation: Activated flash sale on 'Accessory Essentials' bundle (bundle_f3330d7599cf) for testing. Flash sale ends in ~2 hours.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push notification system fully tested. Notification bell in header requires browser Notification API permission (won't work in headless browser). Flash sale toast shows when /api/bundles/flash-sales returns active sales. Toast dismissal uses sessionStorage 'pigma_flash_dismissed'. Service worker at /sw-push.js handles push events. VAPID keys configured in backend/.env and frontend/.env.

backend_admin_stats.test: GET /api/notifications/admin/stats with auth returns 200 with total/active counts

backend_admin_send.test: POST /api/notifications/admin/send with valid data returns 200 with sent_count

backend_flash_auto_trigger.test: PUT /api/bundles/admin/{id} with flash sale fields returns 200

frontend_flash_toast.test: Flash sale toast visible when flash sale is active (data-testid='flash-sale-toast')
Toast shows bundle name and savings amount
Shop button (data-testid='flash-toast-shop-btn') navigates to bundle page
Toast does not show after reload within same session
Toast NOT shown on admin pages (LayoutWrapper hideChrome)

frontend_service_worker.test: Service worker has push event handler with 'Shop Now' action
